content:
nina-fin: Heads-up: I'm seeing a persistent delta between our billing ledger and a third-party metering file for three promo tenants. Vendor counts are higher by ~7-10%.

corey-ops: can you share sample lines (redacted) and whether tags/headers show retries?

nina-fin: pasted redacted rows to vendor ticket: 
`tenant,window,tokens_raw,tokens_billed`
`TEN-7,2026-03-01,45000,48500`
`TEN-21,2026-03-01,30000,32300`

dev-bot: Quick run: internal_sum=525000, vendor_sum=564100, delta=39100. Majority of surplus rows include header flag `x-edge-replayed: true`.

harper: invoice run is scheduled next Fri. Recommend pausing invoice send for tenants where delta > 5% of their monthly charge. Agree?

nina-fin: yes, pause for anomalies under $10k; open an internal hold for any tenant with >5% delta.

corey-ops: I suspect our retry dedupe window didn't cover a new proxy replay behavior. I'll instrument a trace-id pass-through and add a one-off job to join edge logs -> billing events. ETA 24h.

vendor-support: (from vendor) we've received ticket VND-4982 and the raw export. We'll reconcile and reply within 72h. Attaching their raw file now.

harper: policy check: if vendor confirms their overcount, finance will accept vendor credit; if we find duplicate attribution in our pipeline, we absorb. Pre-approved credit threshold: <= $3k without manager sign-off.

nina-fin: opened spreadsheet for affected tenants and flagged holds. I'll also draft the credit memo template and the approval note.

corey-ops: added temporary telemetry to include `replay_id` and `ingest_attempt` in billing records. We'll rerun aggregation after 24h job.

vendor-support: update: initial diff looks correlated to `ingest_attempt>1` events. We're comparing event_ids with your list.

harper: thanks team. Keep this thread updated. If vendor concedes, finance to issue credits per policy above. :thumbsup:
